caption: The drawing depicts a stylized horse, rendered with simplified anatomical features and rounded forms. The body of the horse is predominantly painted in a light grayish tone, overlaid with evenly spaced red and brown spots throughout its surface. The mane, tail, and hooves are colored in a darker shade of brown, with the tail being long and extending downward, also featuring a pattern of darker spots. The horse’s face includes minimal but distinct details: an almond-shaped eye, black lines outlining the mouth, and a black harness running from the cheek down to the body. There is a suggestion of a saddle area indicated by a subtle yellowish outline on the horse’s back. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery present in the composition.
title: Toy Horse
